verdict.rationale: Buzz ships a Desktop-bundled managed agent with a packaged buzz-cli skill covering messaging, channels, workflows, repos and memory. It also ships its own buzz-agent runtime and the buzz-acp harness: you @mention an agent in a channel, it is prompted and acts through the CLI. The vendor's agent-behavior benchmark grades how agents carry out ordinary delegated requests, and a probe confirms the managed skill is live. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that delegating to the built-in agent works in practice, and evidence of a zero-setup experience (the docs describe minting keypairs and configuring an LLM provider).
